svg.title: Local Peer-to-Peer
svg.desc: The browser talks to the device next to it. Securely. Offline. Pair once, origin-scoped, works offline. No cloud, no certificate authority.

g.text: The browser talks to the device next to it.

text.font-family: 'LP2P Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
